premises.text: Healthcare spending growth and new care/payment models create demand for patient relationship management software used by both providers and patients
premises.evidence_span: there's a demand for a new category of software we call patient relationship management

premises.text: Healthcare works best and costs least when patient and provider partner continuously, especially for the 99% of life outside the office visit and for chronic care
premises.evidence_span: healthcare works best and costs least when there's a partnership between the patient and the provider

premises.text: Avado's services framework delivers care-plan trackers, notifications, and provider-fed news to keep patients on plan
premises.evidence_span: this pregnancy tracker is a set of notifications that remind her about upcoming appointments

premises.text: Patients use a connected health-record check-in and Mint-like health dashboard aggregating meds, conditions, allergies, and insurance
premises.evidence_span: it's bringing in the latest information of your medications, your conditions, your allergies, insurance information

premises.text: Business model is freemium features that drive use/virality plus paid Avado and third-party services
premises.evidence_span: the straightforward premium business model, the features that are free are ones that actually drive use and virality

value.text: Patient-provider partnership enabling longer, higher-quality life at lower cost
value.evidence_span: you can live a longer life, higher quality, and actually pay less in the process

causal_links.evidence_span: that partnership is our core focus
the services is some of the magic in our business model

notes: Spend-curve framing and chronic-care $1.8T figure folded into partnership/need domain rather than separate premises (§4.1.6/8). Tracker notifications, check-in, dashboard, and provider newsfeed folded as PRM product cascade (§4.1.7). Early-adopter segments treated as GTM framing inside product need. Three domains—anti-template: freemium/services monetization separately revisable from care-plan UX.
